scripts.project:create: npx wrangler pages project create cozum-emlak --production-branch main
scripts.secrets: npx wrangler pages secret put ADMIN_USER --project-name cozum-emlak && npx wrangler pages secret put ADMIN_PASS --project-name cozum-emlak && npx wrangler pages secret put SECRET --project-name cozum-emlak
scripts.deploy: npx wrangler pages deploy public --project-name cozum-emlak
